card.name: IU and U units after a number
card.fires_on: The unit letters IU or U right after a dose or lab amount, such as million IU, 10 IU/kg, or mIU/mL. Also fires inside international units abbreviations.

modes.label: IU after a number
modes.description: The letters IU follow a numeric dose or concentration, often before /kg or /mL.

modes.label: U or IU in prefixed units
modes.description: The unit letter follows a prefix like m or μ, or follows a bare number as U.
